name: Uncertainty Quantification in Structural Engineering
description: Complete probability space, Wiener process, Ito and Stratonovich calculus, stochastic differential equation (SDE)-s, change of probability measures, Girsanov theorem, numerical integration schemes, Monte Carlo method, process and observation equations, Kallianpur Striebel formula, linear and nonlinear filters, hidden state-parameter estimation using measurement data, estimation of structural damage, Karhunen-Love expansion, polynomial chaos, stochastic finite element method, uncertainty quantification in dams, frames, bridges etc.
